title: Midpoint of a 3D Line Segment
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the coordinates of the midpoint M of the line segment joining A(2, 4, -6) and B(8, -2, 4).

steps.title: Apply Component-Wise Midpoint Formula
steps.explanation: Average the respective x, y, and z coordinates of the segment endpoints.
steps.why: Finding the center of mass of two endpoints.
